Fundraise Up adheres to the highest security protocols and compliance standards, ensuring maximum protection for your nonprofit and donors.

We prioritize transparency in our data handling practices. Our comprehensive Information Security and Data Protection policies are readily available, detailing how we store, transmit, and protect personal information.

We implement rigorous backup and recovery procedures to ensure data integrity and availability.

Our bank-level data protections can guarantee 99.99% uptime year-round, ensuring platform redundancy so your account is always online and your data is secure. Backups are performed daily and retained for a year to meet both operational needs and compliance requirements.

[Learnmore](https://fundraiseup.com/platform/security/#section-guild-bottom)

Fundraise Up has developed a comprehensive, proprietary anti-fraud technology solution, adding an extra layer of protection for nonprofits.

We use a combination of advanced machine learning algorithms and human oversight to detect and effectively prevent fraud. As a result, out of up to 20% of donations that could be fraudulent, we successfully block 98.8% of them.

[Learnmore](https://fundraiseup.com/platform/fraud-protection/)

We have a comprehensive incident response plan to swiftly address and mitigate any security breaches.

Our dedicated [Status page](https://status.fundraiseup.com/) provides real-time updates on our platform’s status, keeping our clients informed about the operational state of Fundraise$ Up.

### Security technologies

###### Encryption

Fundraise Up uses 256-bit encryption to protect organizations and donors from brute-force network attacks.

###### Tokenized payments

Fundraise Up processes transactions directly through Stripe as tokenized payments, ensuring that sensitive payment details are never exposed.

###### Global infrastructure

Fundraise Up ensures 24/7 platform operability and eliminates single-point attacks by distributing its platform globally.

###### Penetration testing

Regular penetration testing identifies vulnerabilities, enhancing security and ensuring your peace of mind.

###### DDoS Protection

AI-powered monitoring detects and eliminates threats, protecting your nonprofit’s online fundraising from attacks.

###### 2FA support

Secure login with two-factor authentication via apps or SMS. Apps ensure access without signal or after SIM changes.

## FAQ

How does Fundraise Up keep donor data secure?

Fundraise Up protects donor data with 256-bit AES encryption at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit, tokenized payments processed through Stripe (so card details never touch our servers), and a globally distributed infrastructure that eliminates single-point-of-failure attacks. We also run daily backups with one-year retention, regular penetration testing, and AI-powered DDoS monitoring.

What security certifications does Fundraise Up have?

Fundraise Up meets leading security, privacy, and accessibility standards, including PCI DSS Level 1 v4.0.1, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, PIPEDA, and WCAG 2.2 AA. Together, these standards support secure payment processing, information security management, EU and Canadian data privacy, and accessible donor experiences. Audit reports and policy documents are available in our Trust Center.

Is Fundraise Up GDPR compliant?

Yes. Fundraise Up is GDPR compliant, along with UK GDPR, PIPEDA, and CCPA. Our platform handles consent capture, donor data access requests, and right-to-erasure workflows — so your nonprofit can collect and process donor data lawfully across regions. View all compliance certifications on our Compliances page.

Does Fundraise Up support Single Sign-On (SSO)?

Yes. Fundraise Up’s SSO supports any SAML-compatible identity provider, including Okta, Google Identity, and Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD). For enterprise nonprofits, this means staff sign in with their existing work credentials and IT teams can centrally manage access — reducing both security risk and operational overhead.

Does Fundraise Up offer two-factor authentication?

Yes. Two-factor authentication is available on all Fundraise Up accounts via authenticator app or SMS. App-based 2FA is recommended because it works without cell signal and survives SIM changes — important for organizations with international staff.

What is Fundraise Up’s uptime?

Fundraise Up maintains 99.99% uptime year-round, including during peak fundraising days like Giving Tuesday and December 31. Our infrastructure is globally distributed, automatically scales, and is monitored 24/7. Daily backups are retained for one year, and we publish a real-time public status page so donors and customers can verify operational status at any moment.

How does Fundraise Up prevent fraudulent donations?

Fundraise Up combines a proprietary fraud-detection AI with behavior analysis, country matching, proxy detection, and human review by our fraud-prevention team. Of donations that could be fraudulent, 98.8% are blocked before they reach your account — protecting your Stripe reputation and reducing chargeback fees. See our Fraud protection page for details.

Where does Fundraise Up store donor data?

Donor data is stored on encrypted, geographically distributed infrastructure with full disk encryption and key rotation. Sensitive payment information is tokenized through Stripe and never stored on Fundraise Up servers. Personal data moves exclusively across private networks. For region-specific data residency requirements, see our Trust Center.

What is Fundraise Up’s pricing?

Fundraise Up is free to start — no setup fees, fixed subscriptions, or long-term contracts. We invest in helping you grow, and our industry-leading fee coverage helps donors offset both Fundraise Up and payment processing costs. The result: an effective Fundraise Up cost of around 1% on average after fee coverage.
